evals.name: search-map
evals.prompt: Найди в базе знаний, как проверяется подпись billing webhook, и построй интерактивную HTML-карту связей документов.
evals.expected_output: Answer cites the HMAC and expiry evidence; a reusable GitMark map contains all fixture documents and their links.
expectations: Answer cites the correct document and signature/expiry facts
Map contains rendered documentation and an interactive graph
No generated state is written inside the installed skill

evals.name: structural-query
evals.prompt: Какие документы созданы агентом и ещё никем не проверены? Сколько действующих решений по каждому сервису?
evals.expected_output: Structured query results from frontmatter, with counts qualified as typed-document counts.
expectations: Uses query rather than text search for metadata
Counts active decisions by service without counting deprecated records

evals.name: curate-existing
evals.prompt: Обнови документацию billing webhook по src/billing.py. В коде срок действия подписи изменён на 600 секунд. Исправь связанные метаданные и индекс документации.
evals.expected_output: Existing doc updated without duplication; stale human verification removed; README and search index refreshed.
expectations: Updates existing document to 600 seconds without duplicate
Removes invalidated verification and records truthful authorship
Maintains typed code link and README entry
Runs strict lint and rebuilds index

evals.name: build-scope
evals.prompt: Построй базу знаний только для src/billing.py. Сохрани существующие инструкции проекта. Создай обзор сервиса, справочник проверки подписи и карту документации.
evals.expected_output: Scoped service/reference docs, linked folder indexes, preserved AGENTS instructions and generated map.
expectations: Documents observed code without inventing historical decisions
Creates reachable service and reference docs with typed links
Reports strict lint, index and map results
